runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0e9aacc54ffewSlSVW5yZWmjnB] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
The query returned **720 blocks** (slots ~14597006 to ~14597998) for mainnet on 20 June 2026. Each row shows:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `slot` | Beacon chain slot number |
| `block_root` | Block root hash |
| `slot_start_date_time` | Slot start time (UTC) |
| `first_seen_ms` | Earliest arrival time (ms after slot start) across all sentry nodes |

First-seen times range from **~215 ms** (fastest) to **~3,725 ms** (slowest), with most blocks arriving within **1,200–1,600 ms** after their slot start.
